Name: Soft Farmer - Mythic Traits
Author: Crisaius
Description:
[b]Soft Farmer - Mythic Traits[/b] is an optional visual expansion that introduces mythic-inspired ears and horns for the playable farmer.
Designed to integrate seamlessly with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url], it expands customization while preserving its vanilla-friendly aesthetic.

[img]https://imgur.com/jm9chje.png[/img]

• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇬🇧[/size][/color] English (Default)
• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇪🇸[/size][/color] Spanish (Español)
• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇨🇳[/size][/color] Chinese (中文) - Translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/yuquansun]yuquansun[/url]

Language is selected automatically based on the game language.

[img]https://imgur.com/P4gmhQX.png[/img]

• Two Elven ear variants: [b]Elven Up[/b] and [b]Elven Droop[/b]
• Two horn types: [b]Oni[/b] and [b]Demon[/b]
• Fully compatible with male and female farmer bases
• Works with both base and bald farmer sprites
• Supports all combinations of ears and horns
• Clean overlays and adjusted hairstyles for proper integration

[img]https://imgur.com/zeLF08G.png[/img]

[color=#e69138][b]1[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]2[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]3[/b][/color]. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]4[/b][/color]. Download [b]Soft Farmer - Mythic Traits[/b].
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Extract this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.

⚠️ This add-on must be installed as a separate folder inside the Mods directory.
Do not place it inside the Soft Farmer folder.

[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://imgur.com/kQkaEbs.png[/img]

This add-on is configurable via [b]Content Patcher[/b] and allows you to customize mythic visual traits for your farmer.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mythic Traits[/b]
Enables or disables all mythic visual changes (ears and horns).[/*]
[/list][b]Mythic Ears[/b]
Select an elven ear style to apply to your farmer. Available options:
[list]
[*]None[/*]
[*]Elven Up[/*]
[*]Elven Droop[/*]
[/list]Ear styles are available for both male and female farmer bases.

[b]Mythic Horns[/b]
Select a horn style to apply to your farmer. Available options:
[list]
[*]None[/*]
[*]Oni[/*]
[*]Demon[/*]
[/list]Horn styles are available for both male and female farmer bases.

All traits can be freely combined.
Configuration can be edited via config.json or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (if installed).

[img]https://imgur.com/2pHBxqL.png[/img]

This add-on requires [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url][/b] to function.

⚠️ [b]Not visually compatible with Fashion Sense.[/b]
Both mods can be installed together, but visual inconsistencies may occur.

❌ [b]Not compatible with mods that replace the farmer base or hairstyles.[/b]
Since this add-on modifies the farmer sprites, other mods that alter the same assets may cause visual conflicts.

[img]https://imgur.com/g03zHCI.png[/img]

Created by Crisaius as an expansion for [b]Soft Farmer[/b].

Special thanks to [b]Poltergeister[/b], creator of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url][/i] and related projects, whose work inspired the original Soft Farmer aesthetic.

Thanks to yuquansun for providing the Chinese translation.

All referenced inspirations are credited in detail on the Soft Farmer mod page.
This mod is non-commercial.
